question: How many orders are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;

question: How many products are in the jackets category?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'jackets';

question: List all store names alphabetically.
sql: SELECT name FROM stores ORDER BY name;

question: What is the average product price?
sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products;

question: Which store has the most orders?
sql: SELECT s.name FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many orders were returned?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned';

question: Total units sold per category.
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.qty) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category;

question: What is the most expensive product?
sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Number of orders per month.
sql: SELECT strftime('%m', order_date) AS m, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY m ORDER BY m;

question: Revenue per store.
sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(oi.qty * p.price) FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY s.id;

question: Which stores are in France?
sql: SELECT name FROM stores WHERE country = 'FR';

question: Products priced above 100, alphabetically.
sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > 100 ORDER BY name;

question: How many orders were placed in March 2024?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31';

question: Which products appear in fewer than 130 orders?
sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id HAVING COUNT(*) < 130;

question: Average number of units per order.
sql: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT SUM(qty) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id);

question: Top 3 products by units sold.
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.qty) AS u FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Return rate per store.
sql: SELECT s.name, AVG(o.status = 'returned') FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id;

question: How many distinct product categories are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category) FROM products;

question: Cancelled orders per country.
sql: SELECT s.country, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY s.country;

question: Cheapest product price per category.
sql: SELECT category, MIN(price) FROM products GROUP BY category;

question: Stores with more than 100 shipped orders.
sql: SELECT s.name FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY s.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 100;

question: What is the date of the latest order?
sql: SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders;

question: Total quantity of items sold.
sql: SELECT SUM(qty) FROM order_items;

question: How many orders contain a tent?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'tents';

question: Revenue per month.
sql: SELECT strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS m, SUM(oi.qty * p.price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY m ORDER BY m;

question: Categories whose average price is above 80.
sql: SELECT category FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING AVG(price) > 80;

question: Pending orders per store.
sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' GROUP BY s.id;

question: Which order has the largest total quantity?
sql: SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Products with 'Trail' in the name.
sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Trail%' ORDER BY name;

question: Which stores sold jackets?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'jackets' ORDER BY s.name;
